Comment: Cust-order-fufillment scenario - cart stage. Checks inventory for every cart item, blocks (reserves) stock while the cart is open and computes the order total with a DuckDB transform. Fails with InsufficientStock when any item cannot be fully reserved.

CheckInventory.Comment: POST /api/fake/commerce/inventory/check - per-item availability for the whole cart. Pure read, blocks nothing.

ValidateAvailability.Comment: Every item must be fully available before stock is blocked.

ComputeTotals.Comment: DuckDB transform: sum qty * unitPriceCents over the cart items.

Parameters.sql: SELECT SUM(qty * unitPriceCents) AS total_cents FROM cart_items

ReserveStock.Comment: Blocks the checked stock until the cart is cleared (cart-cleared flow) or converted to an order (order-placed flow).

InsufficientStock.Cause: One or more cart items have insufficient available stock - see $.inventoryCheck.shortages
